description: This file contains implementation code for a PubSub Rendezvous Grain in the Orleans framework, including classes for managing pub/sub state, handling registration and deregistration of producers and consumers, and facilitating grain state persistence.

classes.name: PubSubGrainStateStorageFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing storage bridges for PubSub grain state, handling the retrieval of storage providers based on stream IDs.

classes.name: PubSubGrainState
classes.description: A serializable data class maintaining the set of producers and consumers for a pub/sub stream.

classes.name: PubSubRendezvousGrain
classes.description: A grain implementing pub/sub rendezvous logic for managing stream producers and consumers, handling registration, deregistration, state validation, and notifications.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Returns a storage bridge for managing the state of a pub/sub rendezvous grain, selecting the appropriate storage provider based on the stream ID.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles the grain activation lifecycle event; reads the persisted state.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer (publisher) for a specific stream ID.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Unregisters a producer from the stream.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer (subscriber) for a specific stream, notifying producers of the new consumer.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a consumer and notifies producers.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Checks that persisted state matches in-memory state to ensure consistency.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a given stream and consumer.
